name: Pirate Express
description: 300 years ago, Captain LaPoutine and his crew, Armando, Burt, Booli and Spewey tried to steal a princess' tiara, but unfortunately they accidentally stole Poseidon's underwear instead. This angered Poseidon and made him shrink the pirates and imprison them in a bottle. In the present day, The pirates were accidentally released by his younger son, Newt. So Newt decided to take control of the pirates and go on adventures with them.

videos.title: Poseidon or Bust
videos.overview: Newt and the Pirates must deliver a shiny new statue of Poseidon to its grand unveiling party.

videos.title: Finders Keepers
videos.overview: The Pirates embark on a mission to return a wallet to an angry Cyclops.

videos.title: Little Miss Swordshine
videos.overview: LaPoutine's great-great-great-great granddaughter turns up claiming ownership of the Pirate Express.

videos.title: Ship Wretched
videos.overview: The Pirates split into two rival parties in a search for treasure.

videos.title: Turkey Leg of Doom
videos.overview: When looking for a giant hairball, Booli ends up taking a mind controlling Turkey Leg

videos.title: Enter the Octogod
videos.overview: Newt and the Crew have to rescue Gordon from octopus worshipping natives.

videos.title: Dead Men Wear Plaid
videos.overview: LaPoutine challenges his rival Captain Skulldidgery to winner-takes-ship race to the edge of the world.

videos.title: Bilge Rat Zombies
videos.overview: On the eve of an inspection, Newt and the Crew discover they have rats on board.

videos.title: Ghost of Ships Passed
videos.overview: Newt pretends to be a ghost to haunt LaPoutine.

videos.title: Night of the Geminis
videos.overview: Newt and the Crew ferry Ted the Cyclops and his brutish twin daughters to Poseidon's party.

videos.title: Ships and Salsa
videos.overview: Armando has a crisis of confidence when he gets a pimple.

videos.title: All A Bored
videos.overview: Newt and the Crew are stranded when the god of wind takes a holiday.

videos.title: Club Fed
videos.overview: Newt and the Pirates must recover Poseidon's lost pet Leviathan from a beach resort.

videos.title: White Wedding
videos.overview: Armando ruins the wedding of Newt's brother when he steals the bride's heart.

videos.title: Saltiest Dogs
videos.overview: Newt and the Crew compete in a pirate reality TV game show.

videos.title: Shrieking Violet
videos.overview: Zeus's spoiled daughter decides she wants LaPoutine as her new pet.

videos.title: Starboard Struck
videos.overview: Renowned actor Johnnie Bermuda joins the Crew to prepare for his upcoming role.

videos.title: Get Kraken
videos.overview: Newt and the Crew fight over an adorable baby orphan kraken.

videos.title: Grill of My Dreams
videos.overview: Newt regrets firing Booli but struggles to get him back after Poseidon hires him as his new chef.

videos.title: Penguin Law
videos.overview: Spewey faces off with his childhood nemesis to determine the future Emperor of the Penguins.

videos.title: Shop 'til You Drop Anchor
videos.overview: Newt takes the Crew gift shopping for the first time in 300 years.

videos.title: Opposites Ahoy
videos.overview: Newt is transported into an opposite world whilst his opposite arrives in Atlantis.

videos.title: Udder Chaos
videos.overview: Newt and the Crew must replace Poseidon's magical bath milk or he will become powerless!

videos.title: Out of Key
videos.overview: Davy Jones pursues Newt and the Crew to get back his stolen locker key.

videos.title: Thumb Wars
videos.overview: Newt and the Crew rescue Burt after a dragon captures him to use as his thumb.

videos.title: One Flew Over the Crow's Nest
videos.overview: LaPoutine's elaborate ruse to reclaim an old treasure gets him stuck in the Pirate Hospital.

videos.title: Game On
videos.overview: Newt and the Pirates are pitted against Zeus' terrifying beasts at a Gods sports day.

videos.title: Licence to Thrill
videos.overview: Newt has to pass his "drivers" test or risk losing control of the Pirate Express.

videos.title: Beast in Show
videos.overview: Newt and the Pirates are sent to retrieve a part-seahorse part-unicorn to help Poseidon win a "Beast in Show" competition.

videos.title: Fine Feathered Fiend
videos.overview: Spewey is pushed out of the crew by LaPoutine's new pet parrot.

videos.title: Lumber Jerk
videos.overview: Newt and the Pirates rescue a wooden boy who then tries to steal their masthead Nelly.

videos.title: Father Time
videos.overview: LaPoutine steals the God of Time's time travelling scythe in order to change history and the captaincy of the Pirate Express.

videos.title: Manure Overload
videos.overview: Newt and the pirates seek a cure for Armando after the monstrous Medusa turns him to stone.

videos.title: No Sea for Old Salts
videos.overview: Newt hooks up with some famous bad boy celebrity pirates and the Pirate Express crew are left out.

videos.title: Sealed Fate
videos.overview: Newt and the Crew set out to rescue Marie-Celeste from the evil clutches of Skulldidgery.

videos.title: Blunder Down Under
videos.overview: Newt and the Pirates pose as plumbers to rescue Spewey from the Underworld.

videos.title: Engaged in Battle
videos.overview: Newt turns matchmaker when Burt reveals he thinks he has a crush on a mermaid.

videos.title: Beggars Can't Be Cruisers
videos.overview: The Pirates start a pirate cruise holiday experience in order to loot their guests.

videos.title: Voyage of the Edam-ed
videos.overview: Newt and the Crew get trapped on the cursed Flying Dutchman ship.

videos.title: Greeced Lightning
videos.overview: Newt and LaPoutine accidentally swap bodies after being struck by Zeus' lightening bolts right before family portrait day.

videos.title: The Godd Couple
videos.overview: Newt and the Crew are forced to babysit Hades' giant three-headed guard-dog Cerberus.

videos.title: Gordon's Fish Tale
videos.overview: Newt and the Crew help Gordon maintain the ruse that he is King of the Oceans when his mother comes to visit.

videos.title: Love on the Rocks
videos.overview: Newt tries to help his Poseidon's flagging pop career but Davey Jones has other ideas.

videos.title: Malaise of the One Eye
videos.overview: Newt and the Crew break Poseidon's trident and make a deal with his enemy, the Cyclops, to fix it.

videos.title: The Future Is Now
videos.overview: The Pirates are duped into buying a 'magic' spyglass that they believe foresees their future.

videos.title: Booty Camp
videos.overview: Poseidon thinks Newt needs to toughen up so sends him to a bootcamp run by Ares, the God of War.

videos.title: Put Another Captain's Log on the Fire
videos.overview: Newt is about to be appointed the permanent captain of the Pirate Express, but his Crew have other ideas.

videos.title: Booty Nights
videos.overview: Newt and the Pirates are framed and sent to jail for a robbery they didn't commit.

videos.title: Fountain of Misspent Youth
videos.overview: The Pirates become babies after falling into the fountain of youth.

videos.title: Jungle Booty
videos.overview: Newt and the Crew embark on a mission to find Eldorado, the long lost city of gold. / Newt and the Crew save Eldorado from Skulldidgery and his thieving band of skeletons!
